# Browser mockup

**Status:** decorative. **Category:** mockups. **In the demo:** `/gallery/mockup-browser`.

This repository's rules come first. Where this page disagrees with [Standards](../standards.md) or
[AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md), they win: no CDN, no npm, no images from other servers, no inline `style` or `onclick`.
Use the [macros](../../../app/ui/templates/ui/macros.html) where one exists.

A browser mockup is a box in the form of a browser window.

[Browser mockup documentation](https://daisyui.com/components/mockup-browser/)

## Class names
- component: `mockup-browser`
- part: `mockup-browser-toolbar`

## Syntax
```html
<div class="mockup-browser">
  <div class="mockup-browser-toolbar">
    {toolbar content}
  </div>
  <div>{CONTENT}</div>
</div>
```

## Rules
- For a default mockup, use only the `mockup-browser` class name.
- To set a URL in the toolbar, add a `<div>` with the `input` class.
